title: Mahidol Study 3: Postoperative Effect and Adverse Events of Regenerative Endodontic Procedures in Immature Permanent Teeth
html: Regenerative endodontic procedures (REPs) have demonstrated high success rates; however, adverse effects and complications remain inadequately characterized. This study investigated the incidence and associated factors of tooth discoloration, intracanal calcification, and treatment failure, including fatal tooth fracture, following REPs in immature permanent teeth.
